tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The table green: page background and the brand colour. Also the icon's rounded square and the browser theme-color. Painted on html; the drifting pattern (pattern_044, 5% multiply) darkens it where the motif is.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Cool white that surfaces are mixed from: every surface and panel is `bg` lightened toward `tint`. Never painted on its own.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Seat rows and bars on the board, translucent so the pattern shows through. Source: color-mix(bg, tint 6%) at 82% — resolved here for the default bg.

tokens.name: surface-me
tokens.usage: The player's own seat row: one step lighter than `surface`. Source: color-mix(bg, tint 11.4%) at 82%.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Opaque sheets and dialogs (result sheet, settings sheet). Source: color-mix(bg, tint 4.4%).

tokens.name: panel-2
tokens.usage: Default buttons, inputs, selects, chips, segmented options and the own panel's tile slot. Source: color-mix(bg, tint 13.2%).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers inside sheets (between wins in the result sheet) and the timer track.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text and icons on `bg`, `surface`, `panel` and `panel-2`; also the selected segment's fill. Measured: 4.5:1 on `bg`, 4.2:1 on `panel`, 3.6:1 on `panel-2` — below 4.5:1 for small text on the panels (source kept exact).

tokens.name: ink-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text: field and legend labels, the tagline, dimmed values, the running timer fill. About 2.7:1 on `bg` — below 4.5:1 (source kept exact); keep it to uppercase labels and non-essential text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Gold. The one call to action per screen (`.btn.primary`: Play, Ron, Tsumo), gold chips, the bank-time timer, the armed-discard magnifier, and 'you' in the brand mark. Text on it: `accent-ink`.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `accent` (primary buttons, gold chips). 9.5:1.

tokens.name: brand-gold-on-light
tokens.usage: The wordmark's i-dots on light backgrounds (the *-on-light brand files). Not used in the UI.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons, 'bad' chips (Furiten, liable), form errors. As text on `bg` it reaches only 1.7:1 (source kept exact) — prefer it as a fill with `danger-ink`.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `danger` fills (danger buttons, bad chips). 6.1:1.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: 'Good' chips (complete hand) and form success text. As text on `bg` 2.9:1 (source kept exact); as a fill with `ok-ink` it passes.

tokens.name: ok-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `ok` fills (good chips).

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Scrim behind bottom sheets.

tokens.name: tile-face
tokens.usage: The ivory face of every tile, and the three opponents' tiles in the brand mark.

tokens.name: tile-edge
tokens.usage: The tile's thickness: a solid offset shadow under the face (0.08 × tile width).

tokens.name: tile-back
tokens.usage: Face-down tiles: the end of a 160° gradient from `tile-back-light`.

tokens.name: tile-back-light
tokens.usage: Face-down tiles: the start of the back gradient.

tokens.name: suit-man
tokens.usage: Corner index of characters (man) tiles, on `tile-index-bg`.

tokens.name: suit-pin
tokens.usage: Corner index of circles (pin) tiles, on `tile-index-bg`.

tokens.name: suit-sou
tokens.usage: Corner index of bamboo (sou) tiles, on `tile-index-bg`.

tokens.name: suit-honor
tokens.usage: Corner index of winds and dragons (E S W N, Wh G R), on `tile-index-bg`.

tokens.name: red-five
tokens.usage: Corner index background of a red five (index text white). Red fives also glow gold as dora.

tokens.name: tile-index-bg
tokens.usage: Plate under the corner index so it reads over the artwork.

tokens.name: haku-frame
tokens.usage: The blue frame drawn on the white dragon (haku) tile.

tokens.name: glow-gold
tokens.usage: Dora halo (incl. red fives). Gold glow means dora and nothing else.

tokens.name: glow-gold-tint
tokens.usage: Tint laid over a dora tile's artwork.

tokens.name: glow-gold-edge
tokens.usage: Tile edge of a dora tile (replaces `tile-edge`).

tokens.name: glow-blue
tokens.usage: Halo on tiles of the same kind as the one the player is holding or hovering. Only then — never automatic.

tokens.name: glow-blue-tint
tokens.usage: Tint over a matching tile's artwork.

tokens.name: glow-blue-edge
tokens.usage: Tile edge of a matching tile.

tokens.name: hint-dot
tokens.usage: The green dot under a suggested discard (hint level 'full' only).

families.sans: "Bricolage Grotesque Variable", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

styles.name: title
styles.usage: h1 of wide pages (admin), and the back arrow (1.4rem).

styles.name: button-big
styles.usage: 56px-tall start buttons on the home and online pages (1.15rem).

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Form errors and success lines, the account chip (0.9rem).

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Round labels, secondary line in buttons (0.85rem).

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Timer seconds (tabular numerals, `accent`) and wait counts (0.7rem).

styles.name: tile-index
styles.usage: Corner index: 34% of the tile width on the board (shown at a 28px tile), min 7px; hidden below 16px tiles. Own hand: 40%, 48% below 32px.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark SVGs (outlined, dotless ı with gold dots), and the seat winds on the board. 800 is reserved for these.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Yaku list rows, tight tile groups.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Chip icon gap, small stacks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Button icon gap, segmented option gap, field label to input, meld gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: The default gap: home column, sheet rows, button pairs in the own panel.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Input side padding, sheet sub-sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Form field stack, sheet content gap.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Gap between fieldsets on narrow pages; sheet side padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Sheet top padding, gap under the tagline.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Page side gutter and button side padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Page top/bottom padding (plus the safe-area inset at the bottom).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Timer bar and its fill.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small inline marks (riichi stick).

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Inputs and selects.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Buttons, segmented options, panels: the house radius (`--radius`).

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets (bottom corners square).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips.

tokens.name: shadow-btn
tokens.usage: Every `.btn`: a hard 2px ledge. Pressed: shadow off and 1px down.

tokens.name: shadow-ghost
tokens.usage: Outline of `.btn.ghost` (Pass, Abort hand).

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The hand magnifier and other floating overlays.

tokens.name: shadow-tile-28
tokens.usage: A tile at 28px width. The real rule scales with the width: 0 0.08w 0 `tile-edge`, 0 0.1w 0.12w black 35%.

tokens.name: control-big
tokens.usage: Start buttons (Play online, Continue, Start).

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every `.btn` and text input: the one-handed touch target.

tokens.name: control-seg
tokens.usage: Segmented options.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Selects and inputs outside forms.

tokens.name: drawn-tile
tokens.usage: Width of the drawn tile in the own panel's middle slot.

tokens.name: timer-height
tokens.usage: The own turn timer bar above the own panel.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Max width of narrow pages (home, login, account).

tokens.name: sheet-max
tokens.usage: Max width of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: band-max
tokens.usage: Max width of a full-bleed band (Band): wider than `page-max` so a hand of tiles gets big; below it the band runs edge to edge.

tokens.name: pattern-strength
tokens.usage: Background pattern layer, multiplied over `bg`.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled buttons.
